title: High Quality Japanese Translations for Popular Cardano DApps

ms.promise: All copy of DJED, Liqwid Finance and Lace Wallet Front-end website translations
ms.criteria: DJED, Liqwid Finance and Lace Wallet front-end websites are translated to Japanese
ms.report:
We are very happy to submit a first Milestone for this proposal.
This time we are submitting a PDF with every word shown in a table (Like DJED example) like suggested by reviewers. This way it will be easy to review the work we have done. 
According to the Change Request* we are delivering Japanese translation for:
• DJED - https://drive.google.com/file/d/1_f593H58FJk8MqNLzXHyg72avppglMmb/view?usp=sharing
• Liqwid Finance - https://docs.google.com/document/d/118Wll6ilC07p9jKxC_PIsxh3gZWElT1l6_CIaEytUhI/edit?usp=sharing
• Lace Wallet - https://docs.google.com/document/d/1rcjMMQzh1yzLc2Aw1friXX40ZZtvO9P50WtaezUcEqE/edit?usp=sharing
All translations are now in PDF format for easier reviews and can be found at
https://github.com/Anastasia-Labs/high-quality-japanese-translation/tree/main/Milestone1
These translations are frontend websites of respective projects translated to Japanese and are available for projects to use and implement on their websites
*Link to the change request: https://drive.google.com/file/d/19OQbH0X6uFz3xUswoA9WbuzlbeoCuDYh/view?usp=drive_link
